## Current-head CI evidence, not a reproduced product failure
PR #183 remains at `539b5b6d04ac42bc4a593de14517bc1b7b1dc803` when checked 2026-10-27 15:49 UTC. All four current jobs completed unsuccessfully after **400 tests passed / 0 failed**, because **99.50% function coverage is below the unchanged 100% threshold**. Line99.63% and branch96.86% satisfy their 99%/96% thresholds.

Verified jobs:
- [Node22](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/actions/runs/40512915488/job/122219039171)
- [Node26](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/actions/runs/40512915488/job/122219039150)
- [npm release gate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/actions/runs/40512915488/job/122219038654)
- [Bun release gate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/actions/runs/40512915488/job/122219039847)

Each retained log reports: `Error: 99.50% function coverage does not meet threshold of 100%.` The coverage report names `index.ts` and uncovered line ranges2314–2315,2368–2369,2649–2653,2664–2669,3711–3712. These include guarded closure/SDK-load/viewer refusal paths; line ranges alone do not identify which missing invocation causes the function percentage.

## Goal and impact
The [canonical field-ownership record](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/539b5b6d04ac42bc4a593de14517bc1b7b1dc803/.agents/pm/features/pm-linear-field-ownership.toon) and PR gate contract keep full current-source npm/Bun verification pending and preserve existing coverage thresholds. The jobs are now terminal failures, not queued. This blocks current-head acceptance without establishing a functional regression, unsafe overwrite, or live-provider failure.

## Acceptance
- Identify missing function invocations from the exact current coverage artifact and add meaningful must-allow/must-refuse tests, or reconcile genuinely unreachable guards with the accepted validation architecture.
- Preserve the existing99%line/96%branch/100%function thresholds; do not exclude source or weaken assertions to make the gate green.
- Rerun current-head Node22/26 and npm/Bun release gates and record exact completed counts.
- Keep the separate atomic replay/revision follow-up distinct.

All183 all-status issue/PR records, PR conversation and canonical feature record checked; no dedicated equivalent CI-gap issue found. Evidence is hosted logs plus static inspection only; no local full suite or provider operation was run. PR183 remains the implementation owner.
